stem.text: In reaction 1, a finely powdered iron catalyst is used.
In reaction 2, a vaporised tetrachloromethane catalyst in ultraviolet light is used.
Which statement about the catalysts used is correct?

A.text: Both reaction 1 and reaction 2 use a heterogeneous catalyst.

B.text: Both reaction 1 and reaction 2 use a homogeneous catalyst.

C.text: Reaction 1 uses a heterogeneous catalyst and reaction 2 uses a homogeneous catalyst.

D.text: Reaction 1 uses a homogeneous catalyst and reaction 2 uses a heterogeneous catalyst.
